map.宠物训练计划生成器 使用指南: Pet Training Plan Generator — User Guide
map.选择宠物种类（犬/猫）、年龄阶段与训练目标（定点排便、随行、唤回等），工具生成每: Choose the pet type (dog/cat), age stage and training goals (house-training, leash walking, recall etc.), and the tool generates daily training items, duration and reward plans, staging progressively harder exercises to help owners build a regular training rhythm.
map.按宠物种类、年龄阶段与选定训练目标，自动生成一周训练课表（天数/每次时长/项目数: By pet type, age stage and selected goals, automatically generate a weekly training schedule (days/session length/number of items).
map.把多个目标（如定点排泄、随行、召回）拆成每日任务，循序渐进、避免一次灌输过多。: Break multiple goals (house-training, leash, recall) into daily tasks, progressing gradually to avoid overload in one go.
map.训导员按计划打卡（勾选完成），直观跟踪每周训练覆盖度。: Trainers check off the plan, visually tracking weekly training coverage.
map.：选择 2 个训练目标、每日 20 分钟：工具输出 7 天周期概览（7 天 /: : with 2 training goals and 20 minutes a day, the tool outputs a 7-day cycle overview (7 days / 20 min per day / several sessions / several items) and rotates tasks across daily slots, each day showing the specific exercises and their goals.
map.按当前宠物种类取对应目标库，把选中目标的任务合并后，按“每日时段表”轮转分配到周: It takes the goal library for the current pet type, merges the tasks of the selected goals, then rotates them across a 'daily slot schedule' from Monday to Sunday; the overview card shows days, minutes per day, session count and total items.
map.能指定某天练某个动作吗？: Can I specify a particular exercise on a given day?
map.当前为自动轮转排布；如需固定某天内容，可在生成后手动调整顺序。计划是训练框架，实: It currently rotates automatically; if you need fixed content on a specific day, reorder it manually after generating. The plan is a training framework—progress flexibly based on the pet's state and positive reinforcement.
